newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian rubber ends week down on Tokyo fall.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian rubber ends week down on Tokyo fall.

text.p: Rubber prices ended the week lower after a weaker close in Tokyo market prompted most buyers to stay at the sidelines, dealers said.

"We don't see much buying because buyers are not commiting themselves due to falls in Tokyo," a dealer said, adding that Europeans were also not actively in the market although the summer holiday was over.
Dealers expect the European buyers to come into the market to make fresh enquiries for SMR CV, SMR L, SMR 5 and drum latex.
At the close, October RSS1 buyer and October SMR 20 buyer eased half a cent each to 324.50 cents ($1.30) and 313 cents a kg respectively.
Buying from Asian consumers, particularly from China, has also slowed down, dealers said.

"Producers are quoting at higher levels and buyers are mostly sidelined," another dealer said, adding that buyers speculated that prices may fall because of increasing supply due to improved weather in some main Malaysian growing areas.
